dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can control the elements though.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Impossible! You're a liar; I've read lots of books about this and I have never come across anyone who doesn't need a Vision to use elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Don't think I'm gonna fall for your lies just 'cause I'm a kid!
